technology_name: MULTI-ROTOR UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE (UAV) FOR PERFORMING SMART FARMING TO INCREASE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Manual soil sampling and terrain mapping workflows across large agricultural spaces are slow, costly, and lack automated depth control to map localized field conditions.
description: A specialized smart farming multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) configuration equipped with a retractable mechanical soil sampling probe, localized sensor nodes, and an autonomous depth controller to extract cores up to 20 cm deep.
applications: Precision agricultural soil mapping, automated farm fertilizer profiling arrays, large-scale terrain analysis grids, and autonomous crop health diagnostic workflows.
